# mtncloud_catalog_item (Data Source)

Looks up one service you can order from the MTN Cloud catalog, by ID or by the name shown in the catalog, with the inputs its order form asks for. To list the catalog, use `mtncloud_catalog_items`; to see what you have ordered, `mtncloud_catalog_orders`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One service from the catalog, with the inputs its order form asks for.
data "mtncloud_catalog_item" "project" {
  name = "Create Project"
}

output "required_inputs" {
  value = [for i in data.mtncloud_catalog_item.project.inputs : i.name if i.required]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Catalog item ID. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name shown in the catalog, matched exactly, for example `Create Project`. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description shown in the catalog.
- `featured` (Boolean) Whether the catalog features this item.
- `inputs` (Attributes List) The inputs of the order form, in the order the console shows them. Empty when the item asks for none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inputs))
- `type` (String) `instance`, `blueprint` or `workflow`.

<a id="nestedatt--inputs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `inputs`

Read-Only:

- `default` (String) Default value, or empty.
- `help` (String) Help text shown on the form, or empty.
- `label` (String) Label shown on the form.
- `name` (String) Input name: the key to give it a value when ordering.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether an order must give it.
- `type` (String) Input type, for example `text`, `select` or `checkbox`.
